note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 94(a), STK 6, Schedule 2-3; A06b Const 94(a), STK 6, Schedule 2-3; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 15 years' residence (the 12 months before the application and the 14 years before them; the dataset's own count is 14); no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Saint Kitts and Nevis, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in St Kitts for 12 months immediately prior to the application (unless person is a British protected person), as well as for 14 years predating the 12-month period. intent to reside in St Kitts required. ... n.a. ... n.a.
